text:
nina: kicked off 5% canary for v3.4-int4 targeting longdoc/summary slices and sampling general chat. will report smoke + slice deltas in 15m
ashok: good. confirm same batching/kv as v3.3?
nina: yes - identical batching, same kv warmup. only quant profile + kernel-schedule changed.
kevin: quick framing: we need an automated gate for longdocs given sensitivity to tokenization/kv. what's our eval window?
tara: 15m windows for this run, matching staging playbook. qa-bot: smoke checks: pass
nina: 15m aggregate deltas:
```
overall_mrr: +0.09%
longdoc_mrr(>2k): -2.1%
hallucination_rate(summaries): +0.37%
p99_latency: +34ms
errors: 0.06% (baseline 0.06%)
```
kevin: ugh longdoc -2.1% on small sample could be noisy. what's N?
nina: ~1.4k longdoc requests in window
ashok: that delta persisted in next 2 windows when we replayed seeds locally. seems consistent
tara: latency +34ms pushes p99 beyond our soft cap. hallucination +0.37% is near the threshold too.
kevin: propose a three-tiered fallback: immediate rollback on severe drops, graduated throttle for borderline metric drift, and shadow replay for postmortem.
ashok: draft auto-fallback proposal: if ANY of:
- longdoc_mrr_rel_drop > 1.0%
- hallucination_abs_delta > 0.3%
- (p99_latency_inc > 25ms AND longdoc_mrr_rel_drop > 0.5%)
then require condition to hold for 3 consecutive 15m windows OR two windows + manual ack. action: rollback slice to pinned v3.3-fp16 and mark variant quarantined.
kevin: add soft-fallback: if hallucination between 0.2-0.3% and longdoc_mrr_rel_drop <1% then shift 30% of slice traffic to fallback route and keep canary at 70% while we debug.
tara: add cooldown 2h before reattempting same quant build. also log token-efficiency gain metric so product can weigh cost vs quality.
nina: putting this into rollout yaml and PR. sample snippet:```
rollout:
  canary: 5%
  windows: 15m
  fallback_rules:
    - id: longdoc_mrr_quick_rollback
      metric: longdoc_mrr
      comparator: relative_drop
      threshold: 0.01
      required_windows: 3
      action: rollback_to: v3.3-fp16
    - id: soft_hallucination_throttle
      metric: hallucination_rate
      comparator: absolute_inc
      threshold: 0.002
      range: 0.002-0.003
      action: split_traffic: fallback:30 canary:70
      cooldown: 2h
```
kevin: also auto-create a shadow replay job on rollback that replays longdoc traces against the canary + baseline for root-cause analysis. tag replays with compile-hash, quant-profile, kernel-seed.
ashok: agree - metadata tagging is critical. add compile-hash and quant-recipe to model metadata so incident logs are actionable.
tara: action items:
- nina: add hysteresis, cooldown and token-efficiency logging in rollout config (ETA 45m)
- kevin: implement shadow-replay creation on rollback trigger (ETA today)
- ashok: formalize gating thresholds in the gating runbook and add examples (ETA EOD)
- tara: run 2 targeted 15m windows focusing longdoc heavy seeds and post results here (ETA immediate)
qa-bot: checklist appended to PR: smoke, seed-replay, slice-breakdown, telemetry tags
nina: pausing promotion until longdoc returns to baseline or soft-fallback stabilizes. will update PR and ping for manual override.
kevin: will hook an alert to #incidents for auto rollback events. request we keep a short postmortem if rollback triggers automatic quarantine.
tara: :thumbsup: keep communications terse on the PR. nina ping me for manual promote.
deploy-bot: Canary run finished (v3.4-int4) — full report: https://internal/reports/1746009999
nina: moving to monitoring mode, will post follow-ups after 3 windows.
